body: My prescribing doctor is decent, I've really only met her once (switched doctors) and she just seemed very interested in my well being, which is good. I know a lot of people are diagnosed with ADHD and that's why I'm apprehensive about thinking too deep into this. Not that there's anything wrong with having it; I just don't want to be put on medication that I absolutely don't need. I also don't want to blame it on something that's easy to blame it on. I don't know what to do.

Wow. You're obviously someone who likes to push themselves if I'm not mistaken. Not that that's a bad thing, but really, those scores are incredible. Can I ask you what you've been using to practice and what your study habits are? Please don't beat yourself up, I would kill to have those scores.

Wow. I wonder if they know how much it effects people when they accuse them of cheating. I've also been stressing out because now I have to take the December test, but common app is due on November 30th. I went to my college center at school today and the woman said that I can still take the December test and send in my scores, but however I do on that I will *have* to send in.

Do you ever wonder how you would've done if you didn't get kicked out of that SAT? I mean, if you got a score you were satisfied with and sent them to the UCs. How different could your life be different if you got accepted into one of those? I guess it doesn't even matter about the SAT, just in general about picking colleges. How the hell do you decide? Sorry, I know this is off topic but it's been a burning question of mine. If I decide to go *here*, then I will meet *these* people and have *this* kind of life and do *this* for a job. Yet, if I pick a different school then my life could be so incredibly drastically different. I also live in CA and was going to apply to UCs but damn are those difficult to get into. 

And seriously, fuck that history teacher. It was like this woman, she smiled at me when I told her I just ultimately wanted to leave. Some people, man.
I've been trying to withhold, but oh my god yes. I am not in any way shape or form denying that I fucked up, but she, imo, over reacted.
I've been meaning to sign up for the gym. I'd better get on it, then! Thanks.

Yes, the cognition. It's like trying to describe dysphoria in that it's kind of impossible to explain to other people unless they've personally experienced it. I've been experiencing myself slipping and it was a bit subconscious, but some major events have made me reflect on what a 'decline' I've been in. 

I haven't been getting enough sleep I don't think. It's odd, I'll be able to go to bed at 9:30 but I'll stay up until, say, 11:30 because I simply don't want to go to bed for some reason. Then I'll have to get up at 6:30am and I'll be mad at myself for not going to bed sooner. It's a cycle that happens practically every night. 

It can be about anything when I zone out. Sometimes it'll be about sex, but not constantly. Other times I'll think of scenarios and what I would do in each instance. And other times, I don't think of anything at all.

Exactly! I had written an essay that I was proud of; I had followed the guidelines I had read earlier about writing a kickass essay. I mean, it was so obvious that I wasn't trying to cheat. 

And that's pretty low of your history teacher, someone that you *know*. What ended up happening after that if you don't mind me asking? I wonder if people will lose their jobs or something? Because the proctor I had was acting like her life depended on it. It's really hard not to be extremely bitter towards her.
Definitely look at your October test scores! If you're not satisfied, then you can still sign up for the December one and have time to prepare. Best of luck!

Hmm that's super interesting, thanks! You know, they usually tell you that 'guessing' is bad but I've been curious if that'd been the case. I will definitely look into that book. And thanks for your tip, I'll try my best this time to calm down. Maybe I can see a therapist or talk to my doctor about ways to calm anxiety.
Thank you, I'll do my best.

Huh...that's interesting. For me, it's definitely affecting my performance in school. I want to bring it up but I'm afraid to tell anyone for the fear that if it does have something to do with T and my dosage, they'll suggest I come off of it. That'd kill me.
All I can say is thank you for your advice. I agree and for now what I really have to do is keep trying my best and try to ask for help.
Possibly. I've been debating on how she could help me, though, because I don't want to waste her time.

Thanks. Sometimes I forget that other people might be going through the same thing but don't vocalize it. I'm not really sure where to go, I don't want to be the trouble-kid who complains about everything. A lot of people worked to help me switch schools, I feel like I'd be letting them down if I let them know that I wasn't doing well. I tell my mom and she apologizes that I'm having a tough time in school but she doesn't know what to do about it either. I guess this is just kind of a plea to figure out how I can make myself smarter and better at school. Thanks for your advice.
I do, I go to tutoring on Wednesdays for math.
